GOOD TO KNOW

A place to practice.
A reason to pause.

RealityQuest is an educational game designed for ages 10–14, with six fictional scenarios. It does not analyze real conversations, identify deepfakes, or certify that a situation is safe.

No name, photo, account, or real message is needed. Game progress is stored in this browser only. Clearing site data may erase it.

Something online made you uncomfortable?

You can stop interacting and talk with a trusted adult — a caregiver, teacher, counselor, or another person who helps you feel safe. If the first person is not helpful, try another. You do not have to work it out alone.

The missions use authored decision rules and explanations, not a live AI model. AI coding assistance was used to build this prototype.
